alkylation_reagent.evidence: The LC-MS/MS data sets were processed by searching all MS/MS data using MaxQuant with the Andromeda search engine, with a mass tolerance of 10 ppm. Label-free quantification (LFQ) was performed for each condition with parameters including trypsin digestion, allowance for 2 missed cleavages, fixed carbamidomethylation on cysteine residues, dynamic AHA-biotinylation (+452.246 Da) on methionine residues, and acetylation at the N-terminus of proteins.

collision_energy.evidence: High-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) was performed at a collision energy of 30%, and MS2 scans were acquired at a resolving power of 30K, using an automatic gain control (AGC) target of 1 × 10⁵ and a maximum precursor ion injection time (ITmax) of 54 ms.

enrichment_method.evidence: For proteomic analysis, samples were digested, enriched for AHA-biotin labeled peptides using streptavidin magnetic beads, and analyzed by LC-MS/MS with a custom-packed column and an Orbitrap Eclipse mass spectrometer.
